title: camelCase mishandles words that contain a number
description: `camelCase` mishandles input in which a word has letters, then a digit, then more letters. For example `b2b_registration_request` should convert to `b2bRegistrationRequest` (and to `B2bRegistrationRequest` with `pascalCase: true`): a digit inside a word must not change the casing of the letters after it. Fix the conversion without changing any other existing behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: behaviour the repository's existing tests cover is unchanged
notes: SWE-bench-style. base_ref is the upstream fix's parent; hidden/test.js is the upstream test file at fix_commit. The scratch repo must hold base_ref's history only (bench/factory/README.md, 'Scratch repositories').
